title: Give OLY-B-A7-04 a verification-tracking status mechanism
summary: Retry of job 20261113-000055-2fae: add a `verification` line to `athena status` (verifier cost, caught, false positives via shared retry-overrule detection, escapes), record it as OLY-B-A7-04's mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml, and verify it against real records with an independent expected range.

defaults_applied.how: Real-records criterion checks the printed figures against independent history.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Retry of job 20261113-000055-2fae (dispatched, never verified, no findings, no candidate changes recorded): nothing to fix from it; the full prior scope is kept as deliverables below and its out_of_scope items are kept. It in turn retried 20261030-033225-g36k.
Goal: give OLY-B-A7-04 a mechanism by adding a `verification` line to `athena status` (verifier cost, rejections caught, false positives, escapes). Audience: Apollo and the owner reading status.

Code survey: crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS, StatusView), crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs, crates/athena-core/src/gate_counts.rs (landed-retry same-change overrule detection), crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/introspection.rs, xtask spec test. No new record or data file is added, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are unaffected.

Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/gate_counts.rs overrule detection is extended/reused by the new verification module; crates/athena-core/src/status.rs and display.rs are extended; docs/enforcement.md and docs/spec.toml are modified.

Environment: `git log` is run locally by the verifier in the repository checkout, read-only, reaching commit times of the working copy history; history.json lives in the evidence directory passed to `status --snapshot`, read-only; no push, CI or network.
Consumers: none found for config; athena.toml and defaults.toml are not changed.
planning.rs is changed only to share or move figure code; its printed figures must not change, which the real-records criterion checks.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml OLY-B-A7-04 has a `mechanism` naming the verification report in crates/athena-core/src/status/verification.rs (not none), keeps owner Apollo, and a `measure` ending with `status: verification`. Check with Grep.

STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs maps the label `verification` to a new StatusView field, and crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs prints a line starting with `verification` from it. Check with Grep.

verification.rs computes false positives by calling the overrule detection shared with crates/athena-core/src/gate_counts.rs (landed retry with the same change), not by testing Fail+Landed combinations; Grep shows the shared function used by both modules.

A unit test in crates/athena-core builds Records shaped like the real writers produce: rejected and passed verifications, job totals, a rejected job later retried ('try again on <job>') with the same change that landed, and a landed job later reverted. It asserts verifier cost, caught, false positives (1) and escapes, fails with the computation stubbed and passes with it. Run `cargo test`.

Real records: run `cargo run -p athena-cli -- status --snapshot <evidence directory>`. On the real records the verification line's false-positive count equals the number of rejected jobs in history.json that have a landed 'try again on' retry with the same change, counted independently from history.json and `git log` commit times; expected range: non-zero (hundreds of retry requests exist) and caught is at least the false-positive count. Also on the real records the planning cost and landing time lines printed (status/planning.rs is touched) are identical before and after, and the landing time is within the expected range taken from commit times in history.json via `git log` (a few minutes, not 0.1 or 273.8).
With empty Records a test asserts the verification line contains `none yet` and does not show zero counts as success. Run `cargo test`.

A test in crates/athena-cli/tests/introspection.rs renders athena_cli::display::status and asserts a line starting with `verification` showing cost, caught, false positives and escaped counts. Run `cargo test`.
The xtask spec test accepts the new measure marker and label, and existing gate_counts tests still pass. Run `cargo test`.
fmt, clippy and test pass: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets`, `cargo test` (recorded on the final tree).
CHANGELOG.md has an added entry using the retry-overrule false-positive definition; docs/enforcement.md gets an M35 row; no existing entry of docs/decisions.md or anything under records/ is edited.

out_of_scope: Changing verifier behavior, verdict rules or gates
Editing existing records/ or docs/decisions.md entries
Building the generic replay check for all status measures (the class-level prevention); only this measure is replayed on real records
departures: Slightly higher cost than reference: new module, shared detection refactor and real-records check.
